name: Samir Saitwal
description: With 5+ years of professional experience, I specialize in developing scalable web applications using Python, Django, and Flask, with strong expertise in REST API development, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Heroku), and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). I have successfully led projects involving sprint planning, team management, and ER model design, delivering machine-learning-based multi-tenant solutions. Skilled across both backend and frontend (HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript), I have optimized application performance with Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ, Celery, and integrated secure payment gateways. Proficient in working with databases such as MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and MySQL, I bring full-stack expertise and a passion for continuously learning emerging technologies.
